_about: County FIPS to Nielsen DMA crosswalk, as used by Drew's Secret 11.5.
_notes: Keys are 5-digit county FIPS (state + county). Values are the DMA name.
Covers all 50 states and DC. US territories are NOT included — they sit outside Nielsen's 210 DMAs.
Marine/offshore SAME zones (pseudo-state prefixes 57,58,59,61,65,73,75,77,91-98) are not counties and are absent by design.
Known corrections carried: Luna NM (35029) -> El Paso; Williams ND (38105) -> Minot-Bismarck-Dickinson; DC (11001); Broomfield CO (08014); Kalawao HI (15005).
Retired Alaska code 02261 (Valdez-Cordova) retained alongside successors so legacy alerts still resolve.
Beltrami MN (27007) -> Minneapolis-St. Paul is correct Nielsen, not an error, despite the distance.
